x86_vaddps_zmm.summary: Add Packed Single-Precision Floating-Point Values (512-bit ZMM)
x86_vaddps_zmm.description: Performs SIMD element-wise addition of 16 single-precision (32-bit) IEEE 754 floating-point values from source register zmm2 and source operand zmm3/m512 (with optional broadcast of a single float32 to all 16 lanes). Stores the result in destination register zmm1 under the control of opmask register k1, supporting optional zero-masking {z}.
x86_vaddps_zmm.affected_flags: None (Floating-point exceptions captured in MXCSR register)
x86_vaddps_zmm.source_db: Intel Architecture Instruction Set Extensions Reference

x86_mov_r64_imm64.description: Loads a full 64-bit immediate constant directly into the destination 64-bit general-purpose register. This is the only x86 MOV variant that accepts an unconstrained 64-bit immediate value without sign-extension.
x86_mov_r64_imm64.source_db: Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer's Manual

x86_cmpxchg_m64_r64.description: Compares the 64-bit value in the RAX accumulator with the destination operand in memory (m64). If equal, the source register (r64) is loaded into destination and ZF is set to 1. If not equal, the destination memory value is loaded into RAX and ZF is cleared to 0. When prepended with the LOCK prefix, executes atomically across cache lines.
x86_cmpxchg_m64_r64.affected_flags: ZF=1 if equal, ZF=0 if not equal; CF, OF, SF, AF, PF updated
x86_cmpxchg_m64_r64.source_db: Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer's Manual

x86_syscall.description: Transitions execution from user space (Ring 3) to kernel space (Ring 0) at the entry point specified in the IA32_LSTAR MSR. Saves RIP into RCX and RFLAGS into R11, while masking RFLAGS using the IA32_FMASK MSR.
x86_syscall.affected_flags: RFLAGS masked by IA32_FMASK MSR; original RFLAGS saved into R11
x86_syscall.source_db: Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer's Manual

x86_cpuid.operands: None (Implicit: EAX, ECX -> EAX, EBX, ECX, EDX)
x86_cpuid.description: Returns processor identification, vendor string, feature flags, cache topology, and extended architectural state support in EAX, EBX, ECX, and EDX based on the input leaf value in EAX and sub-leaf in ECX. Also acts as a serializing instruction.
x86_cpuid.source_db: Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer's Manual

arm64_fadd_vec.description: Adds corresponding 32-bit single-precision IEEE 754 floating-point elements in the four vector lanes of registers v1 and v2, writing the four resulting 32-bit sums into vector destination register v0.
arm64_fadd_vec.affected_flags: None (Cumulative FP exceptions recorded in FPSR)

arm64_ldp_post.description: Loads two 64-bit doublewords from consecutive memory locations starting at base address in Xn into destination registers Xt1 and Xt2, then updates base address register Xn by adding the signed immediate byte offset.

arm64_cas_64.description: Compares 64-bit value in register Xs with the 64-bit value in memory at address [Xn]. If equal, writes 64-bit value from Xt into memory. In all cases, loads the original value from memory into Xs.

arm64_pacia.summary: Pointer Authentication Code (Key A, Data Modifier)
arm64_pacia.description: Calculates and inserts a cryptographic Pointer Authentication Code (PAC) into the unused upper bits of the 64-bit pointer in Xd, using Key A and the modifier value in Xn.

armv7_add_r.description: Adds the 32-bit value in register r2 to r1, placing the sum in destination register r0. If conditional execution codes (e.g. ADDEQ, ADDNE) are specified, the instruction executes only if APSR flags satisfy condition.
armv7_add_r.affected_flags: APSR (N, Z, C, V updated if S suffix specified)

armv7_vadd_f32.description: Performs parallel SIMD addition of four single-precision 32-bit floating-point elements from 128-bit source registers q1 and q2, placing the four sums into 128-bit destination register q0.

rv_vadd_vv.description: Performs element-wise addition of active elements in vector register group vs2 and vs1 under mask vm, writing elements to destination vector vd according to current SEW (Selected Element Width) and LMUL (Vector Register Multiplier).

rv_jalr.summary: Jump and Link Register (Indirect Control Transfer)
rv_jalr.description: Sets the program counter (PC) to (rs1 + sign-extended 12-bit offset) with the least-significant bit forced to zero. Simultaneously stores the return address (PC + 4) into destination register rd (commonly ra / x1).

rv_lr_w.description: Loads a 32-bit word from memory address in rs1 into destination register rd and registers a reservation on the memory address. Used in pair with SC.W (Store-Conditional) to implement lock-free atomic read-modify-write sequences.

rv_sc_w.description: Conditionally writes the 32-bit word in rs2 to memory address in rs1 if a valid reservation from a prior LR.W exists on the address. Writes 0 to destination register rd on success, or non-zero on failure.

rv_c_addi.description: Adds non-zero sign-extended 6-bit immediate to value in register rd and writes result back to rd. Provides a dense 16-bit encoding for the common `addi rd, rd, imm` instruction.

add.description: Adds source operand to destination operand and stores result in destination register. Updates standard arithmetic status flags if architecture supports flag modification.

sub.description: Subtracts source operand from destination operand and stores result in destination register. Evaluates borrow and overflow status.

adc.description: Adds source operand and current Carry flag (CF) value to destination operand, storing sum in destination. Used for multi-word / multiprecision arithmetic.

sbb.description: Subtracts source operand and current Carry/Borrow flag value from destination operand, storing difference in destination.

mul.description: Performs unsigned integer multiplication of operands, producing double-width product across register pair or destination register.

imul.description: Performs two's-complement signed integer multiplication, preserving sign across destination register or multi-register product.

div.description: Divides accumulator value by source operand, producing unsigned quotient and remainder.

idiv.description: Divides sign-extended dividend by divisor operand, computing signed quotient and signed remainder.

and.description: Computes bitwise logical AND of source and destination operands. Each bit of result is 1 if and only if both corresponding input bits are 1.

or.description: Computes bitwise logical inclusive OR of source and destination operands. Each bit of result is 1 if either corresponding input bit is 1.

xor.description: Computes bitwise logical XOR of source and destination operands. Often used to zero a register when applied to identical operands (`xor reg, reg`).

not.description: Inverts all bits of the operand, replacing 0s with 1s and 1s with 0s without altering condition flags.

neg.description: Replaces operand value with its two's-complement arithmetic negation (0 - operand). Sets Carry Flag (CF) to 1 unless operand is 0.

shl.description: Shifts operand bits to the left by count, shifting in zeros at the least-significant bit position. High-order bits are shifted into Carry Flag.

shr.description: Shifts operand bits to the right by count, shifting in zeros at the most-significant bit position. Low-order bits are shifted into Carry Flag.

sar.description: Shifts operand bits to the right by count while preserving the sign bit (most-significant bit replicated), performing signed integer division by powers of 2.

rol.description: Rotates operand bits to the left circularly by count; bits shifted out of MSB wrap around into LSB and are copied into Carry Flag.

ror.description: Rotates operand bits to the right circularly by count; bits shifted out of LSB wrap around into MSB and are copied into Carry Flag.

popcnt.description: Counts the number of bits set to 1 in the source operand and stores the integer count in the destination register. Sets ZF=1 if source is 0.

lzcnt.description: Counts the number of continuous zero bits starting from the most-significant bit (MSB) to the first set bit. Sets CF=1 if input is zero.

tzcnt.description: Counts the number of continuous zero bits starting from the least-significant bit (LSB) to the first set bit. Sets ZF=1 if input is zero.

bswap.description: Reverses the byte order of a 32-bit or 64-bit general-purpose register, converting between little-endian and big-endian representations.

clz.description: Counts the number of consecutive zero bits starting from the MSB of the source operand and writes the count to destination register.

ctz.description: Counts the number of consecutive zero bits starting from the LSB of the source operand and writes the count to destination register.

cpop.description: Counts the number of 1-bits in register rs1 and writes the integer sum to destination register rd.

mov.description: Copies data from source operand to destination operand without modifying condition flags.

lea.description: Computes the effective memory address from the memory operand expression (base + index * scale + disp) and stores the resulting address directly in the destination register without accessing memory.

ldr.description: Loads a word, doubleword, halfword, or byte from memory at the effective target address into the destination register.

str.description: Writes the value from the source register into memory at the computed target address.

ldp.description: Loads two consecutive registers from adjacent memory addresses in a single atomic memory pipeline operation.

stp.description: Writes two consecutive registers to adjacent memory addresses in a single memory pipeline operation.

push.description: Decrements the stack pointer (RSP/ESP/SP) by the operand size and copies the source operand onto the top of the stack.

pop.description: Loads the value from the top of the stack into the destination register and increments the stack pointer (RSP/ESP/SP) by the operand size.

jmp.description: Transfers program execution control unconditionally to the target code address specified by label, register, or memory offset.

call.description: Pushes the return address (address of the instruction immediately following CALL) onto the stack and jumps to the target procedure entry point.

ret.description: Pops the return address from the top of the stack into the instruction pointer (RIP/EIP/PC), resuming execution in the caller procedure.

b.description: Transfers program execution to the target label or PC-relative offset. If condition suffixes (e.g. BEQ, BNE) are applied, branch occurs only if condition holds.

bl.description: Stores the address of the next instruction (PC + 4) into the Link Register (LR / X30 / R14) and branches to target address.

blr.description: Stores the address of the next instruction into Link Register LR and branches to the dynamic address stored in the specified register.

bx.description: Branches to target address in register, switching CPU state between ARM mode (32-bit) and Thumb mode (16/32-bit) according to bit 0 of target address.

blx.description: Stores return address in Link Register, branches to target address, and switches execution mode between ARM and Thumb state.

cbz.description: Tests if the value in source register is equal to zero, branching to PC-relative target offset if zero without modifying condition flags.

cbnz.description: Tests if the value in source register is non-zero, branching to PC-relative target offset if not zero without modifying condition flags.

tbz.summary: Test Bit and Branch on Zero
tbz.description: Tests a specific bit position in register, branching to target address if the tested bit is 0.

tbnz.summary: Test Bit and Branch on Non-Zero
tbnz.description: Tests a specific bit position in register, branching to target address if the tested bit is 1.

jal.description: Adds 20-bit signed PC-relative immediate to PC to compute jump target, while writing return address (PC + 4) into destination register rd (default ra / x1).

beq.description: Compares registers rs1 and rs2, branching to PC-relative offset if rs1 == rs2.

bne.description: Compares registers rs1 and rs2, branching to PC-relative offset if rs1 != rs2.

blt.description: Compares signed integers in registers rs1 and rs2, branching to PC-relative offset if rs1 < rs2.

bge.summary: Branch if Greater Than or Equal (Signed)
bge.description: Compares signed integers in registers rs1 and rs2, branching to PC-relative offset if rs1 >= rs2.

bltu.description: Compares unsigned integers in registers rs1 and rs2, branching to PC-relative offset if rs1 < rs2 (unsigned).

bgeu.summary: Branch if Greater Than or Equal (Unsigned)
bgeu.description: Compares unsigned integers in registers rs1 and rs2, branching to PC-relative offset if rs1 >= rs2 (unsigned).

fadd.description: Performs IEEE 754 floating-point addition across scalar or parallel SIMD vector lanes, generating sum with dynamic rounding.

fsub.description: Performs IEEE 754 floating-point subtraction (dest - src) across scalar or parallel SIMD vector lanes.

fmul.description: Performs IEEE 754 floating-point multiplication (dest * src) across scalar or parallel SIMD vector lanes.

fdiv.description: Performs IEEE 754 floating-point division (dest / src) across scalar or parallel SIMD vector lanes, updating exception status on divide-by-zero.

fsqrt.description: Calculates the IEEE 754 square root of source operand, writing result to destination register.

fmadd.description: Computes (src1 * src2) + src3 with a single rounding step at the end, eliminating intermediate rounding error and improving numerical accuracy.

fmsub.description: Computes (src1 * src2) - src3 with a single final rounding step.

fnmadd.description: Computes -((src1 * src2) + src3) with a single final rounding step.

fnmsub.description: Computes -((src1 * src2) - src3) with a single final rounding step.

vaddps.description: Performs SIMD element-wise addition of single-precision (32-bit) IEEE 754 floating-point values across 128-bit (XMM), 256-bit (YMM), or 512-bit (ZMM) vector lanes.

vaddpd.description: Performs SIMD element-wise addition of double-precision (64-bit) IEEE 754 floating-point values across 128-bit (2 lanes), 256-bit (4 lanes), or 512-bit (8 lanes) vector registers.

vmulps.description: Performs SIMD element-wise multiplication of 32-bit floating-point values across vector lanes.

vmulpd.description: Performs SIMD element-wise multiplication of 64-bit floating-point values across vector lanes.

vsubps.description: Performs SIMD element-wise subtraction of 32-bit floating-point values across vector lanes.

vsubpd.description: Performs SIMD element-wise subtraction of 64-bit floating-point values across vector lanes.

vdivps.description: Performs SIMD element-wise division of 32-bit floating-point values across vector lanes.

vdivpd.description: Performs SIMD element-wise division of 64-bit floating-point values across vector lanes.

vfmadd132ps.description: Multiplies vector operand 1 by vector operand 3, adds vector operand 2, and overwrites vector operand 1 with final single-rounded result: `dest = (dest * src3) + src2`.

vfmadd213ps.description: Multiplies vector operand 1 by vector operand 2, adds vector operand 3, and overwrites vector operand 1 with final single-rounded result: `dest = (dest * src2) + src3`.

vfmadd231ps.description: Multiplies vector operand 2 by vector operand 3, adds vector operand 1, and overwrites vector operand 1 with final single-rounded result: `dest = (src2 * src3) + dest`.

aesenc.summary: Perform One Round of AES Encryption
aesenc.description: Applies ShiftRows, SubBytes, MixColumns, and AddRoundKey transformations of the AES algorithm to 128-bit state in source register using 128-bit round key.

aesdec.summary: Perform One Round of AES Decryption
aesdec.description: Applies Inverse ShiftRows, Inverse SubBytes, Inverse MixColumns, and AddRoundKey transformations of the AES algorithm to 128-bit state using 128-bit round key.

aesenclast.summary: Perform Last Round of AES Encryption
aesenclast.description: Applies ShiftRows, SubBytes, and AddRoundKey transformations (omitting MixColumns) for the final round of AES encryption.

aesdeclast.summary: Perform Last Round of AES Decryption
aesdeclast.description: Applies Inverse ShiftRows, Inverse SubBytes, and AddRoundKey transformations (omitting Inverse MixColumns) for the final round of AES decryption.

cmpxchg.description: Compares value in accumulator (AL/AX/EAX/RAX) with destination operand. If equal, loads source register into destination and sets ZF=1; otherwise loads destination into accumulator and clears ZF=0.

xchg.description: Swaps the contents of source and destination operands. When referencing memory, automatically asserts bus LOCK signal on x86 processors.

xadd.description: Exchanges first operand with second operand, then loads sum of both values into first operand. Commonly used with LOCK prefix to implement atomic fetch-and-add.

syscall.description: Invokes operating system kernel service at Ring 0 via MSR entry point, saving user RIP into RCX and RFLAGS into R11.

sysret.description: Returns from Ring 0 to Ring 3 64-bit user code, restoring RIP from RCX and RFLAGS from R11.

svc.description: Generates a supervisor call exception, transferring execution to operating system exception vector at Exception Level 1 (EL1).

smc.description: Generates a Secure Monitor Call exception to transition execution to Exception Level 3 (EL3, Secure Monitor).

hvc.description: Generates a Hypervisor Call exception to transition execution to Exception Level 2 (EL2, Virtualization Host).

ecall.description: Makes a service request to execution environment / operating system kernel by raising an environment-call exception at U-mode, S-mode, or M-mode.

ebreak.description: Transfers control to debugging environment by raising a breakpoint trap exception.

wfi.description: Suspends CPU core execution and puts processor into low-power idle standby state until a hardware interrupt or wake-up event occurs.

hlt.description: Stops instruction execution and places CPU in a halted low-power state until an enabled interrupt (NMI, SMI, INTR) or reset occurs.

pause.description: Provides a hint to the processor that the executing code is inside a spin-wait loop, reducing pipeline power consumption and preventing memory order violation penalties upon loop exit.

cpuid.description: Returns processor identification and hardware feature flags in EAX, EBX, ECX, EDX based on input leaf value in EAX.

rdtsc.description: Loads current 64-bit processor cycle count from Time-Stamp Counter into EDX:EAX.

rdtscp.summary: Read Time-Stamp Counter and Processor ID
rdtscp.description: Reads 64-bit cycle count into EDX:EAX and processor/core ID into ECX, serializing prior instruction execution.

fence.description: Orders device I/O and memory accesses as viewed by other RISC-V harts and external devices.

fence.i.description: Synchronizes instruction cache fetches with prior data memory writes, ensuring newly generated / self-modifying code is visible to instruction pipeline.

dmb.description: Ensures that all explicit memory accesses occurring in program order before the barrier are observed by other cores before any explicit memory accesses after the barrier.

dsb.description: Acts as a strict synchronization barrier: completes all prior memory accesses and cache/TLB operations before any subsequent instruction can execute.

isb.description: Flushes instruction pipeline and fetches subsequent instructions from cache or memory, ensuring context/system register changes take effect.
